svg.title: Norton's dome and its arc-length coordinates
svg.desc: An accurately parametrized surface of revolution, truncated at r = 0.55 in units with g = k = 1. Below, its vertical cross-section distinguishes arc length r from horizontal distance x and vertical drop h. The summit has a horizontal tangent despite divergent curvature.
svg.text: r: distance along the gold arc
Rotate this profile about the vertical axis.
